meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aUb5PjustUhygUZ7A_playbook
actions:
  Create_Enrichment_Variables:
    title: Create Enrichment Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: Define Enrichment Provider and Enrichment Response Array
    on-success:
    - Conditional_Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Provider
      value: AbuseIPDB
    - name: Enrichment
      value: []
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 067fe041-8f10-4a49-ab43-17781f75f4aa
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 619e0004-135a-431f-9066-e6595db550d8
  Conditional_Parallel:
    title: Conditional Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: Handle various conditionals
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - NOOP: {}
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - IP_Address
    actions:
      Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
        title: Create TEDS Enrichment
        type: transformation
        description: Create a TEDS enrichment based on the retrieved reputation information
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_IP: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          enrichment_verdict:
            title: Enrichment Verdict
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (

                    $abuse_confidence_score := actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data.abuseConfidenceScore;

                    $abuse_confidence_score > 75 ? "malicious"
                    : $abuse_confidence_score >= 25 ? "suspicious"
                    : $abuse_confidence_score < 25 ? "benign"
                    : "unknown"

                )
              data:
                actions:
                  AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          abuseConfidenceScore:
                            $:ref: $actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data.abuseConfidenceScore
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_timestamp
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_timestamp:
            title: Enrichment Timestamp
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '($lastReportedAt := actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data.lastReportedAt; $lastReportedAt ? $lastReportedAt : $now())'
              data:
                actions:
                  AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          lastReportedAt:
                            $:ref: $actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data.lastReportedAt
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_permalink
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_permalink:
            title: Enrichment Permalink
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '"https://www.abuseipdb.com/check/" & inputs.observable.observable_value'
              data:
                inputs:
                  observable:
                    observable_value:
                      $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_context
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_context:
            title: Enrichment Context
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (
                    $data := actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data;

                    $context := $data ? "Whitelisted: " & $data.isWhitelisted & ", Country Code: " & $data.countryCode & ", Is TOR: " & $data.isTor & ", Usage Type: " & $data.usageType & ", Domain: " & $data.domain
                             : "No Context Provided"
                )
              data:
                actions:
                  AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          $:ref: $actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body.data
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment:
            title: Enrichment
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                {
                    "enrichment_type": "reputation",
                    "enrichment_provider": variables.Enrichment_Provider,
                    "enrichment_verdict": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict,
                    "enrichment_timestamp": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp,
                    "enrichment_permalink": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink,
                    "enrichment_context": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context,
                    "enrichment_raw_data": actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body
                }
              data:
                variables:
                  Enrichment_Provider:
                    $:ref: $variables.Enrichment_Provider
                actions:
                  Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
                    result:
                      enrichment_verdict:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict
                      enrichment_timestamp:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp
                      enrichment_permalink:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink
                      enrichment_context:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context
                  AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result.json_body
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: enrichment_verdict
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: dfc1af11-bd55-431b-86a8-644af577aa7c
        outputSchemaReferenceId: a4eb4e86-652e-4ac4-95db-613da2891eaa
      Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment:
        title: Create TEDS Error Enrichment
        type: connector
        description: ""
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Error_IP: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aT0MBgT0PDhSCQjJu_playbook
        inputs:
          error_provider: '{$:ref: $variables.Enrichment_Provider}'
          error_status: Error
          error_result: '{$:ref: $actions.AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address.result}'
        pool: $default
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        testInputs: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: ff54adc7-2272-4c84-8c15-4d66635c949a
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 9cd4490f-e0e4-462f-829a-2b616087f5f0
      AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address:
        title: AbuseIPDB Check IP Address
        type: connector
        description: Check IP address
        on-success:
        - Create_TEDS_Enrichment: {}
        on-failure:
        - Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment: {}
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: abuseipdb.check
        inputs:
          parameters:
            ipAddress: '{$:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value}'
        pool: $default
        asset: AbuseIPDB_API_Key_Credential
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        environment: {}
        testInputs:
          parameters:
            ipAddress: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: a7234193-6502-4a74-a05b-8b9c3e288f11
        outputSchemaReferenceId: b49214fc-5bae-4b8e-998e-9deef23ae692
      IP_Address:
        meta: {}
        title: IP Address
        type: conditional
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: If the observable is a supported type
        conditions:
        - action: AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address
          condition:
            $:or:
            - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
              - $:match: ipv4_public
              - ignoreCase: false
            - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
              - $:match: ipv6_public
              - ignoreCase: false
        else: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: f49fa612-770b-44d1-a94b-09e3e397b09e
        outputSchemaReferenceId: e2fa0d43-bf00-49fa-98c6-dcb886ebcd19
      Update_Enrichment_IP:
        title: Update Enrichment (IP)
        type: updateVariables
        description: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 33658e4e-e674-4b9e-978a-ddb1b7ac00bb
        outputSchemaReferenceId: d217d195-9034-4dbc-8cf5-892b9d4f65c1
      Update_Enrichment_Error_IP:
        title: 'Update Enrichment (Error: IP)'
        type: updateVariables
        description: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment.result.published.enrichment
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 18fe3c68-c2a3-43b5-8863-ad4aab6f54e1
        outputSchemaReferenceId: f1f9e061-5af2-496e-aa23-19163201cbea
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: f3a54d96-c757-46cb-8263-8cc952b5b4da
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 509feb33-1a73-47a4-94b3-7459b3ac8c00
  NOOP:
    title: NOOP
    type: transformation
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations: {}
    entrypoint: ""
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: b6e1d280-caff-40e7-860d-1bbb8b91a3ad
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 933319b7-8856-4442-b0de-aff5c3e4a887
meta:
  customActionInputSchema:
    Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment: {}
    AbuseIPDB_Check_IP_Address: {}
title: component_aJpxP4W3QYnQiHHKd_playbook
description: Enriches observables using AbuseIPDB API. Accepts IPv4/IPv6 public addresses and produces TEDS-compliant enrichment output.
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Create_Enrichment_Variables
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  enrichment:
    $:ref: $variables.Enrichment
environment: {}
outputSchemaReferenceId: cccda0ee-713e-41db-8c11-af5224ae324a
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 2d33721d-a84a-4faf-b1a7-102a050a23fa
